learning_outcomes.text: Effective use of information sources and resources of communication and assisted professional training (Internet portals, specialized software applications, databases, online courses, etc.) both in Romanian and in a language of international circulation.
Improving English knowledge to reach the level of language competence that would allow understanding and producing accurate academic and scientific texts in English.
Understanding written or verbal texts on topics related to the field of engineering in general and the chosen specialization in particular.
Producing written texts or expressing oneself verbally in English.
Completion of documents specific to the chosen field of study.

syllabus_topics: Introductory seminar. Test for the evaluation of students’ level of English language skills.
Drawings in engineering: Drawing types and scales. Reading. Vocabulary and conversation exercises.
Types of views used in engineering drawings. Vocabulary exercises.
Design development: the initial design phase. Collaborative development of engineering projects. Reading and vocabulary exercises.
The degrees of comparison for adjectives and adverbs (revision exercises)
Engineering Design. Technical Drawing in Engineering. Types of Views Used in Engineering Drawing. Listening and speaking exercises.
Design objectives and design calculations. Vocabulary and speaking exercises.
Expressing dimensions of circles (key dimensions of circles, expressing the dimensions of pipes and ducts). Reading and vocabulary exercises.
Dimensional accuracy. Discussing the concepts of precision and tolerance in engineering. Vocabulary and speaking exercises
Expressing numbers and calculations. Decimals and fractions. Addition, subtraction, multiplication and division. (Listening and vocabulary exercises)
Expressing area, size and mass. Referring to weight, mass, volume and density.. (Reading and exercises)
Measurable parameters. Defining the concepts of supply, demand, capacity, input, output and efficiency in relation to the engineering domain. (Reading and conversation exercises)
3D component features (referring to 3D forms of edges and joints and the 3D forms of fasteners) Reading and vocabulary exercises.
Revision of the concepts relating to the engineering domain discussed during the semester.
assessment_rules: Students are required to solve exercises testing acquired knowledge. The minimum mark for passing the exam is 5, requiring knowledge of fundamental notions without details. For a mark of 10, thorough knowledge of all subjects is required. Mandatory presence at 80% of seminars is a condition for development.
